investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Quilloxa Travel (travel booking); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.223.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster quillo-prod-apnort (EKS); Database: postgres instance itinerary-db-01 for itinerary-api; Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
